throughline.zh: 本週首則已查證新聞涉及政府無人機的晶片來源清查，連結電子零組件追溯、整機採購與交貨驗收。
throughline.en: The first verified story this week concerns drone chip-origin reviews, linking component traceability with public procurement and delivery acceptance.

title.zh: 無人機晶片來源與政府採購查核
title.en: Drone chip provenance and public procurement

summary.zh: 內政部 10 月 31 日初步盤點 3 個機關涉及亞拓相關無人機採購共 32 架，包含移民署 30 架、總價 275 萬元但尚未交貨的合約。主管機關將核對非紅供應鏈規範，晶片來源與個案違約責任尚未有最終結論。
summary.en: On October 31 Taiwan's Interior Ministry identified 32 drone procurements across three agencies, including a NT$2.75 million, 30-unit immigration contract not yet delivered. Component provenance and contractual liability remain under investigation.
